strings.zh: 模仿古代的精灵{NEWLINE}建造的东西。
strings.en: It’s a replica of an ancient Pokémon.

strings.zh: 嗯⋯⋯！{SCROLL}我已经从事遗迹的{NEWLINE}研究很多年了,{CLEAR}有什么东西和往常⋯{CLEAR}不太一样⋯⋯{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hmm.{SCROLL}I have been studying the ruins for many{NEWLINE}years, but something feels...{CLEAR}different.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 喔喔！{SCROLL}墙壁上画着的{NEWLINE}未知图腾⋯⋯！{SCROLL}未知图腾的眼珠子{NEWLINE}好像在盯着我看⋯⋯！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Wow!{SCROLL}The Unown pictures on the wall...{SCROLL}The Unown’s eyes seem to be{NEWLINE}staring at me!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0084/2; modernised from US 0084#2 | RV032: omission: 未知图腾的眼珠子 (the Unown's eyes) restored

strings.zh: 什、什、什么⋯⋯！？{NEWLINE}不祥的气息！{CLEAR}我止不住⋯⋯{CLEAR}脚{CLEAR}脚上的颤抖！！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Wh-wh-what...?! An ominous presence! I{NEWLINE}can’t stop... my l-legs from shaking!!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0084/3 | RV032: voice: stutter 什、什、什么 and 脚 脚 restored; 不祥的气息 = ominous presence

strings.zh: 哈哈,你没事吧！？{NEWLINE}你突然就从我的眼前{CLEAR}消失了,{CLEAR}吓死我了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Ha ha, are you all right?! You suddenly{NEWLINE}vanished right in front of me. You{CLEAR}scared me half to death!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0084/4 | RV032: softened: 吓死我了 = scared me to death, not 'made me so surprised'; 哈哈 kept

strings.zh: 原来如此,原来如此,{SCROLL}阿尔宙斯和未知图腾力量的影响下{CLEAR}产生了巨大的能量,{CLEAR}让你飞到了{CLEAR}神都遗迹吗？{SCROLL}未知图腾和阿鲁夫的遗迹和{NEWLINE}还有阿尔宙斯⋯⋯{CLEAR}谜题越来越复杂了！{SCROLL}我的好奇心{NEWLINE}也越来越强烈了！{SCROLL}什么时候一定{NEWLINE}要解开这个谜！{SCROLL}
strings.en: I see.{SCROLL}The power of Arceus and Unown affected{NEWLINE}each other to create a huge energy,{CLEAR}which sent you to the Sinjoh Ruins...?{SCROLL}Unown, the Ruins of Alph, and Arceus...{CLEAR}The mystery deepens...{SCROLL}It has made me even more inquisitive!{SCROLL}I will one day solve all the mysteries!{SCROLL}
